GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well off the rails gate didn't look to lead balancing up third fence 2 Lengths (1400m), box seating travelled well 600, asked to go 500 coming off Inside , paired out late did enough to win again # box seat/solid late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 300m disappointed for a run, steadied and shifted in to obtain clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well off the rails gate settled down behind the leader fence 2 Lengths (1400m), enjoying a perfect trip To The Turn , Straightened Up around leaders & called upon, hit lead 200 dashed away # enjoyed gun run

Jumped well settled down third off the fence 2 Lengths (1400m), Two Wide second 1 Lengths away 800, on terms into the Straight all out though, two horse duel last 100 or So & this a shade too solid # dug very deep
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Vetted pre-race after having raced on 10-8-26. Rdr explained after consultation with Tnr, it was decided to try and settle further forward. Tnr stated intention was to be better than midfield but with the slow tempo early, settled more forward than expected.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 6 Lengths Two Wide , hooked 3 Wide at 650m and Moved Up to trail 1 length 3 Wide turning, hit Lead Straightening Up , got away and kept going in straight. (Blinkers AGAIN) # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Restrained and shift out across heels passing 1300m. Passing the 600m, laid out and continued to lay out for a short distance after. Raced wide throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained Straight Out The Back 8 Lengths out 3 Wide x 1300m again Two Wide @ rear @ 800m, went Five Wide Turning for home clear run home Outside kept trying without threatening Closest on line, Need To See Again - # had no favours
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide without cover until the 700m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field on inside (5L from lead). Back 2 Lengths midrace & pushed to chase @ 500m. Pressured on inside @ 400m & no improvement from home turn. # Never in it.

Jumped okay & Settled Down 4 Lengths Two Wide , out 3 Wide after first turn, Drifted Back to 8 Lengths 3 Wide turning, improved to 5th place in straight. [Stewards: COT - Intend to be more forward. Settled worse than midfield.] # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: C/O/T-intention to be more forward. Settled worse than midfield. Raced wide without cover.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok Not Bustled settled down worse Mid Field 7 Lengths (1400m), closer in a bunching field before Turn , Straightened Up held up! Going back between rivals 250 squeezed through late should have finished closer # margin unfair
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When being held up approaching the home turn, bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: (ex Kris Lees) Jumped ok Not Bustled settled down 6 Lengths off the lead Two Wide (1200m), Wide & well back Ridden Along To The Turn , Straightened Up starting to wind up deepest, kept coming into third (Blinkers OFF FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie FIRST TIME) # from a mile back!

Jumped only fairly, worked up and trailed less than a length Four Wide entering first turn, pressed on and up Two Wide Outside Lead by the 1050m, Drifted Back to 2 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: it was caught very Wide early, worked forward and settled outside the leader, he endeavoured to keep it travelling on the bridle for as long as possible but it failed to respond strongly when asked to sprint approaching the home turn. He added it had raced like a tired horse. Post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormality.] # wide/worked early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, rdr stated mount was caught very wide, without cover, in early stages before he worked forward to settle outside leader app 1000m. Rdr stated, appreciating tough run mount had in early stages, he endeavoured to keep it travelling on bridle for as long as possible before asking it to sprint app h/home turn. Rdr stated mount failed to respond strongly to his efforts & was plain to the line. Rdr added that his mount raced like a tired horse. P/R vet no ab's.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths Two Wide , raced same middle stages until moving forward from the 950m, took Lead Two Wide at the 600m, led 2 Lengths turning, joined and Headed at 150m but fought on and only bested 50m from post # battled on ok
